items.title: Does NRG’s New Wharton Gas Capacity And Dividend Payout Change The Bull Case For NRG (NRG)?
items.summary: NRG Energy, Inc. recently paid a quarterly dividend of US$0.4750 per share on August 17, 2026, following an ex-dividend and record date of August 3, while also commencing commercial operations of 456 megawatts of new natural gas-fueled capacity at its TH Wharton Generating Station. Together with the scheduled second-quarter 2026 results release on August 4, the new Wharton units highlight how NRG is leaning on gas-fired generation to support reliability amid growing electricity demand.
